metadata.label_policy: Manual visual inspection of raw frames; no detector coordinates used as reference labels. Unclear or hidden ball positions must not be invented.

split_policy: Chronological blocks: train through 239, validation 245-269, test 275 onward. Three-frame causal inputs, no shared input frames. External audit never used to train/select thresholds.
limitation: Seed annotations are approximate and from one court/short clip. These splits do not demonstrate cross-camera generalization.
